The following sections of Contract No.4989between the City of Cheyenne and Rocky
Mountain Pipeline System, LLC dated November 30,2006 are hereby amended:
1.Section 2.Permission Granted.
a.The City hereby grants to the Company limited permission to install a
petroleum pipeline along the public right-of-way in Cheyenne, Wyoming, fora
distance of approximately thirteen thousand, three hundred thirty two (13,332)
linear feet. The specific area where the pipeline will be installed is contained in
ExhibitA tothe agreement.With this amendment, the City hereby grants to
the Company limited permission toinstall two additional petroleum pipelines
along the public right-of-way in Cheyenne, WY for a distance of
approximately one thousand four hundred(1,400) linearfeet eachas shown
in the attached Exhibit B.
b. This permission for use is granted for a period not to exceed ten (10) years
commencing upon executionof thisthe original agreement.
2.Section 5.Legal Construction.
This agreements hall notbe construed as a comprehensive franchise agreement.
Its terms are limited to the approximately thirteen thousand three hundred thirty
agreement and the additional two thousand eight hundred (2,800) linearfeet
granted under this amendment.Any expansion beyond thatinitial pipeline
installation shall require amendment of this agreement with the City of Cheyenne.
This agreement is entered into for the benefit of the Company, as installation of
November,2006, and the City of Cheyenne does not intend to burden or delay
such installation.
